6b. Advance to 3 (PC start 1): cooldown active 1 start remaining, due 6
6c. Advance to 6 (PC start 2): cooldown released by authenticated boundary
7. Stage 5: Cast D2 (Ward Timed, target-next-start, cooldown 2) on A at seq 6
7b. Advance to 8 (A's start): DR expires at 8, cooldown stays active
7c. Advance to 12 (PC start 2): D2 cooldown released at 12
8. Stage 6: Cast D3 (Ward Counted 3, cooldown 1) on A at seq 12
8b. Advance to 15 (PC start): D3 cooldown releases at 15 while DR effect stays active
8c. Combination refusal: attempt recast on A is refused without spend or cooldown
9. Stage 7: Coincident boundary with roster [PC, B, A]
9b. Advance to 18: Coincident boundary releases cooldown and expires DR in one boundary transition
9c. Legal reuse after coincident boundary succeeds once
